server_scripts.name: Threat Discovery — Validate Existing Sources
Threat Discovery — Check Duplicates & Reachability
Threat Discovery — Save to ERP
server_scripts.script:
saved_sources = []
saved_keywords = []

for kw in (task_data.get("keyword_result") or {}).get("keywords") or []:
	keyword_name = (kw.get("keyword") or "").strip()
	if not keyword_name or frappe.db.exists("Threat Keyword", {"keyword": keyword_name}):
		continue
	keyword_doc = frappe.get_doc({
		"doctype": "Threat Keyword",
		"keyword": keyword_name,
		"language": kw.get("language", "English"),
		"source_type": "AI Generated",
		"is_active": 1,
		"date_added": frappe.utils.today(),
	})
	keyword_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
	saved_keywords.append(keyword_doc.name)

for source in task_data.get("extracted_sources") or []:
	source_doc = frappe.get_doc({
		"doctype": "Threat Source",
		"source_name": source.get("source_name"),
		"source_type": source.get("source_type", "Other"),
		"source_url": source.get("source_url"),
		"language": source.get("language", "English"),
		"discovery_context": source.get("discovery_context"),
		"status": "Pending",
		"discovered_date": frappe.utils.now(),
	})
	source_doc.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
	saved_sources.append(source_doc.name)

frappe.db.commit()

result["saved_sources"] = saved_sources
result["saved_keywords"] = saved_keywords
